settings.eyebrow: BriefSieve by Braivex · The operator's daily brief
settings.heading: BriefSieve
settings.lede:
A daily marketing brief for business operators.
Ad ROAS, cross-channel marketing, social, email, sales, marketplaces, competitors, industry buzz, inbox and calendar on one screen.
A guru you can question explains the numbers and is never allowed to calculate them.
settings.metric: Ten data sections, your own API keys, one brief

settings.label: The morning brief
settings.value:
A brief written from last night's syncs: what moved, what is running low, what worked.
Three things worth your attention before you open a single dashboard.

settings.label: Ten sections, overview and detail
settings.value:
Ad ROAS, cross-channel marketing, social, email, sales, Amazon, competitor watch, product launches, industry buzz, and inbox with calendar.
Each has a global date range, a compare period and trend charts.

settings.label: Ask the guru
settings.value:
A chat that answers from your own figures, remembers your context per user, and cites the sync it drew from.
It narrates numbers that code has already computed.
It is never allowed to do the arithmetic on money or metrics.

settings.label: Your channels, your keys
settings.value:
Connect Meta, Google and TikTok Ads, Instagram, Shopify, Klaviyo, Dynamics, Amazon Seller Central, Gmail or Outlook with calendar, and Reddit through OAuth.
Credentials are yours, stored encrypted, never custodial.

settings.label: Roles that match a real business
settings.value:
Admin, finance, marketing, stock and tech each see what they need.
The permission matrix is editable per workspace.
Every write is logged.

settings.label: Buzz: what the market is saying
settings.value:
Trend and celebrity monitoring for your category, in several layers.
The brief tells you what customers are about to ask for as well as what they bought last week.

settings.heading: A marketing manager who has already read everything.
settings.lede: Built for the operator who runs ads, stock, email and a marketplace at once and would rather be told what changed than go looking.

settings.heading: The model never calculates money.
settings.body:
Code calculates every figure in the brief from the synced data, then hands it to the guru to explain.
The guru can tell you why ROAS fell and which campaign moved it.
It cannot invent a total, round a margin or estimate a number it was not given.
If a figure is not in the data, the brief says so.
settings.quote: Numbers are calculated first, then explained.

settings.q: Does the AI calculate my numbers?
settings.a:
No.
Code calculates totals, ratios and comparisons from the synced data.
The guru explains them and points to the sync they came from.
It is not allowed to calculate money or metrics itself.

You do.
Keys and tokens are stored encrypted in your workspace and used only to sync your data.
You can bring your own AI provider key as well: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq or OpenRouter.

settings.q: Can finance see something different from marketing?
settings.a:
Yes.
Five roles ship by default: admin, finance, marketing, stock and tech.
The permission matrix is editable per workspace.
Every write is recorded in an audit log.

The product is built and running for its first operator.
We onboard early-access customers ourselves.
They get a direct line for connector requests and keep their launch price.
